about_intro_html:
MusicTagStudio is a local metadata editor, music catalog and audio tool for Windows.

Project page: github.com/pcblizzard/MusicTagStudio

Version: {version}
License: {license}
Copyright: © 2026 Michael (pcblizzard)

Interfaces used:

    {interfaces}

The availability of individual interfaces depends on the settings, credentials and the respective provider.
acoustid_tip: For identification by acoustic fingerprint. Leave empty to use the bundled app key.
add_source_first: Please add a music source first.
album_rg_tip: Additionally analyses all selected tracks of an album as one coherent album.
amazon_search_tip: Search Amazon for artist + album (e.g. for CD/vinyl)
analysis_running_close: The audio analysis is still running. Really cancel and close?
analysis_summary_stat: {total} tracks · {cache} from cache · {newly} recalculated · {seconds} seconds · avg {avg} seconds per track
apple_album_failed: Apple album could not be loaded: {message}
apple_album_loaded: Apple album loaded: {injected} of {total} tracks matched.
apple_link_hint: Apple Music did not reliably recognise this album. Paste the Apple Music link (or the album ID) below to load the correct, position-accurate tracklist directly.
apple_link_provider: Please paste an Apple Music link or an Apple album ID.
apple_link_required: Please paste an Apple Music link or an album ID.
apple_not_found: Apple Music: no unambiguous edition found.
apple_web_fallback: Use Apple Music web search as fallback
apple_web_fallback_tip: If the iTunes search API does not find an album, the public Apple Music website is searched additionally. This also finds albums the search API does not index (metadata only, no login).
artist_levels_tip: Number of folder levels to go up from the album folder to the target folder of the 400 px cover.
audio_unreachable: The selected audio file is not reachable.
audio_unreachable_edit: The audio file is currently unreachable and cannot be changed.
audit_summary: {files} files · {albums} albums · {errors} errors · {warnings} warnings · {info} notices · health {health}/100
batch_confirm_msg:
The marked fields will be applied to {count} tracks.

Unedited fields and individual track numbers remain unchanged.
batch_cover_info: {albums} albums · {tracks} audio files · {existing} existing master covers. Existing master covers are reused. For missing covers the best supported source is chosen automatically.
batch_info: {count} tracks selected. Preferred source: {source}. Common album values and individual track values can be checked separately. The selected values are written directly to the selected audio files after confirmation.
batch_legend: Green: preferred source · Blue: supplemented value · Orange: conflict between sources
cache_cleared_msg: Cached Apple and MusicBrainz responses were removed. Albums are re-queried on the next tagging.
check_lrclib_tip: Queries only lyrics already stored at LRCLIB.
clear_cache_tip: Discards cached Apple and MusicBrainz responses. Albums are re-queried on the next tagging.
comp_info: Preferred source: {source}. You can choose between the available values for each field individually. Only the later click on “Save changes” writes to the FLAC file.
comp_legend: Blue: supplemented by another source · Orange: providers return different values
contributors_html:
Contributors

Michael / pcblizzard
Project idea, development, testing and maintenance

View contributors on GitHub
cover_dialog_info: The dialog opens immediately. The cover sources are queried in parallel and the original file is only downloaded after the selection.
cover_edition_tip: Cover of the currently selected edition
cover_fallback: Use another supported source if no suitable cover is found
cover_ref_placeholder: Optional: Apple Music album link, Apple ID, MusicBrainz release link or MBID
cover_sources_info: Metadata and cover source are independent. Red means the source is currently not usable in MusicTagStudio.
dashboard_subtitle: Manage your library, edit metadata and check your collection.
debug_placeholder: MusicBrainz requests, HTTP status and hit counts appear here.
different_values_tip:
Different values within the selected tracks:
{values}
direct_album_done_msg: {count} tracks were updated via the direct album link.
direct_album_info: MusicTagStudio first builds a complete one-to-one mapping between local files and album tracks. File name, title, disc/track number, duration and order are evaluated together. You can change each mapping manually before comparing.
direct_album_placeholder: Apple Music album/song link or MusicBrainz release
direct_album_title: Load album or song via provider link
discogs_info: Without a token the media library uses MusicBrainz only. With a token Discogs adds labels, formats, covers and missing releases.
discogs_no_mb_artist: MusicBrainz returned no artist. Searching Discogs for exact artists, labels and releases.
discogs_refresh_tip: Ignores the local Discogs database and reloads the discography via the API.
discogs_token_tip: The token is stored only locally in config.toml and used for requests to api.discogs.com.
embed_note: Existing embedded lyrics are replaced. Other metadata and an existing LRC file remain unchanged.
enrich_missing: Fill missing fields from other supported sources
excerpt_tip: Shows the matching excerpt only for locally stored lyrics. The Genius API does not return a specific passage.
feature_artist_only: Guest in the artist field only
feature_title_artist: Guest in the title and artist field
ffmpeg_missing_long: FFmpeg and ffprobe were not found. Analysis is only available after setup.
ffmpeg_missing_short: FFmpeg and ffprobe were not found.
folder_not_found_msg:
The music folder was not found:

{folder}
fpcalc_tip: Optional path to the Chromaprint binary fpcalc.
fuzzy_suggestion: No exact match. Did you mean: {links}?
history_empty: No changes have been written in this session yet.
identify_by_sound_tip: Identifies the selected track by acoustic fingerprint (AcoustID) and suggests matching MusicBrainz metadata.
identify_file_missing_msg: The audio file was not found.
identify_no_key_msg: No AcoustID key is configured. Please enter an AcoustID application key in the settings (from acoustid.org/new-application).
identify_no_match_msg: The acoustic fingerprint did not match any MusicBrainz entry.
ignore_cache_tip: Unchanged files are normally loaded from the local analysis cache.
karaoke_tip: Karaoke highlights synchronised lines in time with playback.
label_artist_derived_tip: Derived from the main-artist entries of the Discogs releases.
label_represented_tip: Source: Discogs label releases. No confirmed contractual relationships.
rename_pattern_hint: Placeholders: {track}, {title}, {artist}, {album_artist}, {album}, {disc}, {year}, {genre}. The file extension is kept.
premium_required_msg: This feature is part of the premium version. Enter a valid license key in the settings to unlock it.
library_sources_info: Multiple local drives, external disks and network paths can be indexed together. Unreachable sources stay visible in the index.
load_direct: Load album/song by link or ID
load_direct_tip: Load an album or song by URL or ID
load_sources_startup: Load configured sources automatically at startup
lrclib_incomplete: LRCLIB requires title, artist, album and a readable track duration. Local lyrics can still be used.
lrclib_live_tip: Deliberate live query; LRCLIB may check additional external sources.
lrclib_no_match: LRCLIB found no matching lyrics for this track.
lrclib_offline: LRCLIB is currently unreachable. Local lyrics remain available.
lyrics_embedded: Lyrics were embedded in {format} as confirmed.
lyrics_enabled_hint: Show lyrics for the selected track
lyrics_no_embedded: Note: the audio file is available locally but contains no matching embedded lyrics, and no matching .lrc file or lyrics cache entry was found either.
lyrics_search_intro: Enter a distinctive line of lyrics. Locally stored lyrics are searched first, then optionally Genius.
lyrics_search_placeholder: For example: Welcome at the end, at the end of the road
lyrics_search_tip: Search local lyrics and Genius for a fragment
mapping_incomplete_msg: Before comparing metadata, each local file must be mapped to exactly one album track.
mapping_summary: {artist} – {album}: {auto} of {total} files mapped automatically. {ambiguous} mapping(s) should be reviewed.{note}
min_chars: Please enter at least three characters of the lyrics.
ml_explanation: Search for artists, view releases and editions, and load tracklists on demand. Streaming and quality checks only start on button press.
ml_local_not_indexed: The local album files have not been indexed yet. Please refresh the library data first.
ml_no_local_tracks: No reachable local tracks were found for this album.
ml_track_no_local: The selected track could not be matched to a local file.
more_artist_hint: Select tracks with the same album artist.
more_artist_tip: Open the artist's discography in the media library
no_artist_image_tip: Neither Apple Music nor Discogs provides a suitable artist image.
no_audio_msg: No supported audio files were found in the selected folder.
no_changes_msg: There are no changes to save. The selected values already match the existing files.
no_genius_token: No Genius token stored yet. Local search still works; you can add the token under Settings > Online catalogs.
no_hits_meta: Neither MusicBrainz nor the active catalog returned an exact match.
no_hits_status: No artists, labels or releases found.
no_local_lyrics: No lyrics found from local sources.
no_local_lyrics_hint: No local lyrics found. LRCLIB has not been queried yet.
no_master_compare: No existing master cover to compare with.
no_source: No active music source has been configured.
one_to_one_required: A one-to-one mapping is required. These album tracks were selected more than once: {tracks}
parallel_jobs_tip: Automatic uses up to four parallel FFmpeg processes on typical systems. A higher number can speed up the analysis but puts more load on the machine.
peak_status_tip: True peak classification: up to +1 dBTP unremarkable, above +1 to +2 dBTP elevated, above +2 dBTP critical.
prerelease_note: · Pre-release (release: {day}). Tracks not yet released are listed as placeholders (Track N) on Apple and update on reload after release.
prerelease_tip: Listed on Apple as a pre-release; some tracks may not have been released yet.
preview_source_setting_tip: Source for the 30-second track preview in the media library.
preview_tip: Play a 30-second preview of the mapped album track
provider_priority_info: The selected source has priority. Other supported sources can only fill in missing fields.
quality_check_msg: The quality check deliberately stays manual. Reliable bit depths and sample rates still require the official or authorised interfaces of Qobuz, TIDAL and Deezer. MusicTagStudio therefore does not show guessed values for now.
rel_none_from_releases: No artist assignments derivable from releases
relations_tip: Clicking an artist opens their discography.
release_hint_multi: The selection contains multiple albums. Please select only the tracks of a single album.
release_hint_none: Select the tracks of an album to create a BBCode text template.
release_hint_ok: Creates the BBCode text template for the selected album.
release_multi_album_msg: Please select only the tracks of a single album for the text template.
releases_loading_mb_discogs: Loading releases by {artist} from MusicBrainz and Discogs…
scan_sources_startup: Scan for new or changed audio files at startup
select_cover_for_compare: Please select a cover for the image comparison.
show_lyrics_tip: Show lyrics from LRC, audio file or LRCLIB
show_timestamps_tip: Shows the LRC timestamps for synchronised lyrics.
skipped_files_log_msg: {count} file(s) could not be read. Technical details are in the logs.
song_link_needs_file_msg: Please select exactly one local file when using an Apple Music song link.
source_unreachable_tip: The album is indexed, but the music source is currently unreachable.
sources_update_failed_title: Music sources could not be refreshed
spectrogram_ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is not available. The spectrogram cannot be created.
spectrogram_hint: Select an analysed track to show the spectrogram.
spectrogram_load_failed: The generated spectrogram could not be loaded.
streaming_checking: Checking Apple Music, TIDAL and Spotify…
streaming_info: TIDAL and Spotify are used for catalog matching. Genius supplements the search for a song by remembered lyrics. Full lyrics are not taken from Genius.
streaming_not_checked: Streaming and quality have not been queried.
title_unavailable_msg: The local track is no longer in the current library.
track_peak_tip: Linear ReplayGain peak value calculated from the measured true peak.
tracks_loaded_some_local: {count} tracks loaded · {local} of them available locally (green = present, red = missing).
true_peak_tip: True peak also accounts for peaks between the digital samples. The sample peak can therefore be unremarkable while the true peak indicates possible clipping.
unmapped_files: {count} local file(s) are not mapped yet.
unsaved_multi_msg: The changes for {count} tracks have not been saved yet.
unsaved_single_msg: The changes have not been saved yet.
windows_credential_tip: Stored via the Windows Credential Manager and not written to config.toml.
write_rg_question:
ReplayGain tags will be written to {count} files.

Overwrite existing ReplayGain tags?
